s-1.ptxt: Dispose of Back Door Stay Assembly LH

s2.ptxt: With the piston rod extended, secure the back door stay assembly LH in a vise.
Using a hacksaw, cut between A and B shown in the illustration to release the gas.

item.ptxt: Wear protective goggles when performing this work.
The enclosed gas is colorless, odorless and harmless, but cover the area with a shop rag or similar, as hacksaw chips may fly.
